description.zh: 朱权编《神奇秘谱》，收录《流水》。现存琴谱提供的是曲目流传的书面证据。
description.en: Zhu Quan’s Shenqi Mipu includes Flowing Water. The surviving tablature documents the work’s transmission.

title.en: Tang Xianzu completes The Peony Pavilion

description.zh: 1598年对应剧本写成。昆山标记对应昆曲传承，国会图书馆所藏版本属于后来的刻本。
description.en: The year dates completion of the play. The Kunshan marker locates the opera tradition. The Library of Congress holds a later printed edition.

title.en: Sanqing Anhui troupe arrives in Beijing

description.zh: 三庆班入京参加乾隆万寿演出。后来徽、汉等声腔与表演在京交流，京剧逐渐形成。
description.en: The Sanqing troupe came to Beijing for the Qianlong emperor’s birthday celebrations. Anhui, Han and other traditions subsequently interacted in the formation of Peking opera.

title.en: Abing records Moon Reflected on Second Spring

description.zh: 杨荫浏、曹安和在无锡以钢丝录音机记录阿炳的演奏。此处年份对应采录。
description.en: Yang Yinliu and Cao Anhe documented Abing’s performance with a wire recorder in Wuxi. The year dates the recording.

title.zh: 管平湖版《流水》随旅行者号发射
title.en: Guan Pinghu’s Flowing Water travels on Voyager

description.zh: 旅行者金唱片选入管平湖演奏的《流水》。地图标示演奏家相关地点，北京与金唱片的发射地点分属不同地理语境。
description.en: The Voyager Golden Record carries Guan Pinghu’s performance of Flowing Water. The map shows the performer’s associated city, Beijing. The spacecraft launched elsewhere.

title.zh: 昆曲列入联合国教科文组织代表作名录

description.zh: 昆曲于2001年获首批人类口头和非物质遗产代表作称号，2008年纳入非物质文化遗产代表作名录。
description.en: Kunqu was proclaimed a Masterpiece in 2001 and entered the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2008.

title.zh: 南音列入联合国教科文组织代表作名录

description.zh: 2009年的列入记录体现当代保护与传承。
description.en: The 2009 inscription records contemporary recognition and safeguarding.

title.zh: 京剧列入联合国教科文组织代表作名录
title.en: Peking opera enters UNESCO’s Representative List

description.zh: 2010年列入代表作名录，申报资料描述了京剧的表演、音乐与传承方式。
description.en: Peking opera entered the Representative List in 2010. The nomination documents performance, music and transmission.
